system.description:
Tomb-breakers, vault-crackers and the trap-setters of border forts: they know how a trap thinks because they build them.

  • Set and Spring: you can set a trap you disarmed, a hunting trap, a snare or a bag of caltrops in one round. In a fight, a creature that triggers a trap you set makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or is Restrained until the end of its next turn, and takes your Exploit damage die on top of the trap's own effect.
    • 9th level: you can have two traps set at once in a fight.
  • Tomb-Wise: Advantage on checks about ruins, tombs, vaults and the people who built them.
